column1: # The engine API (the function tables of the engine modules, src/game/PyInterface/*.c with SD_PY_MODULE, and the
# original's PvP mode modules of src/game/Script/Split.c): Module.Function, tag, why. Tags: SIM (changes the world,
# server only), DEF (definitions both sides make the same way: classes, resources, graphs of the level's data),
# PRES_STATE (presentation a late joiner must see: kept state), PRES_EVENT (one-shot presentation), UI (the acting
# player's menu, HUD or input), QUERY (reads, no change), CLIENT (client only: video, config, console, files),
# NET_OLD (the original's network API). tools/script/netclass.py checks that every function has a tag.
